text.offer: Fehr'loi Qan says, "Trolls. Big ones. Ukgoth's full of them, and they worship a lump of mana in the middle of it they call the Heart of Zjiria. I've sold a lot of good steel to folk going to see it. Some of them even came back to buy more."
text.progress: From Tos: out the main gate, through the Twisted Wood to the Cragged Mountains, then into Ukgoth, Holy Land of Trolls. The Heart of Zjiria is the node at its centre.
text.complete: Came back, did you? Good. Steel needs sharpening after trolls.

steps.objective: Bond with the Heart of Zjiria in Ukgoth
